dedupe_keys.name: 防災マッフ fire police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 防災マップ [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 草津市. 市内における避難所の位置図. Coverage: 草津市. The portal files it under the publisher 草津市. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設. It offers 15 resource(s) in csv, kml, zip. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
